name: amp-openloop
description: Error-amplifier open-loop gain, UGBW, phase margin, systematic offset, Iq and pass-gate drive extremes across full PVT.
claim: design/error_amp.md -- error-amplifier contribution to the ratified README rows for PSRR (> 50 dB @ 1 kHz, stretch 60 dB), Iq (< 30 uA), load regulation (< 1%) and the +/-2% output-accuracy window. Amp-level only: the closed-loop LDO claims are #10 (stability) and #12 (testbench suite).
analyses: meas ac a0_db find vdb(vg1) at=0.1
meas ac ugbw_hz when vdb(vg1)=0 fall=1
meas ac ph_ugbw find vp(vg1) when vdb(vg1)=0 fall=1
meas ac g1k_db find vdb(vg1) at=1k
meas ac ph1k find vp(vg1) at=1k
meas ac a0ll_db find vdb(vg2) at=0.1
meas ac g1kll_db find vdb(vg2) at=1k
meas ac a0dr_db find vdb(vg3) at=0.1
meas ac g1kdr_db find vdb(vg3) at=1k
meas ac apk_db max vdb(vg1) from=2e5 to=5e6
meas ac a200k_db find vdb(vg1) at=2e5
meas ac apkll_db max vdb(vg2) from=2e5 to=5e6
meas ac a200kll_db find vdb(vg2) at=2e5

operating_conditions.load_current: N/A -- amp-level characterisation. The amplifier drives the pass-device gate and has no load pin of its own; the load-conditioned LDO claims belong to #10/#12.
operating_conditions.amp_output_load: 6.14 pF lumped, on every instance -- the measured worst-case Cgg of the pfet_03v3 pass device at W = 4 mm / L = 0.28 um, ss / -40 C (sim/devchar/CONCLUSIONS.md S1)
operating_conditions.output_cap: N/A -- the external output capacitor is outside the amplifier boundary (the DR-0001 window is verified by #10)
operating_conditions.input_common_mode: 1.2 V, the feedback-node voltage of ldo_core's ratified divider (beta = 2/3, 1.8 V out from a 1.2 V reference; DR-0003's offset gain-up 1/beta = Vout/Vref = 1.5)
operating_conditions.bias: self-biased from VDD (Rbias + MB1 inside the cell); there is no external bias pin. The amp's own Iq is measured here; the reference block's Iq is a separate budget line.
operating_conditions.enable_state: N/A -- the ratified 5-port interface (INP INN OUT VDD VSS) has no enable pin; ldo_core's Men clamp gates the pass device, not this cell. Shutdown Iq is #11's claim.
operating_conditions.output_operating_point: X1 servo'd to OUT = 2.0 V (the ~50 mA regulation point at Vin = 3.3 V); X2 servo'd to OUT = VDD - 0.4 V (light load); X3 servo'd to OUT = 1.0 V at VDD = 2.10 V (README note 4's dropout test point); X4 driven 250 mV below balance at VDD = 2.10 V (gate pulled low); X5 driven 250 mV above balance (gate pulled high)

a0_db.description: DC gain floor for load regulation < 1% and line regulation < 5 mV/V (DR-0004's line-reg revisit trigger is 'DC loop gain below ~54 dB'); the amp is the dominant term in that loop gain

gain_1k_db.description: PSRR(1 kHz) = A_amp(1 kHz) * beta (design/error_amp.md), so the 50 dB PSRR row needs 50 - 20*log10(2/3) = 53.5 dB of amp gain at 1 kHz

gain_1k_lightload_db.description: same floor at the light-load operating point -- README note 1 makes 1 mA the binding load for PSRR

gain_1k_dropout_db.description: NOT a spec floor: the ratified PSRR row is verified over Vin 2.97-3.63 V (README note 1), not at the 2.10 V dropout test point. This asserts only that the amp keeps useful bandwidth there -- the supply-referenced bias runs at roughly half current at 2.10 V -- so the loop can still regulate while dropout is measured.

pm_deg.description: the amplifier's own phase margin driving 6.14 pF, i.e. the stability row's PM >= 45 deg criterion applied to the block. The LDO loop's margin is #10's claim, not this one. CAUTION (issue #53): this is computed as 180 + vp(), and ngspice's vp() WRAPS to (-180, 180], so a forward path carrying 288 deg of lag at unity gain reports here as 252 deg and clears this bar. This row therefore cannot on its own distinguish a well-compensated amplifier from one whose local loop has rotated the phase by +180 deg -- that is what peak_excess_db below is for, and this bar is kept unchanged rather than reinterpreted so the two are independent.

vos_sys_uv.description: systematic input-referred offset allocation: 2 mV (design/error_amp.md offset table)

iq_ua.description: error-amp bias allocation from spec/architecture-survey.md S5 (10-15 uA of the 30 uA whole-regulator budget); the Iq row binds ff/125C/3.63V

tail_hdr_mv.description: TAIL must stay at least a Vdsat (~175 mV at MTAIL's current density) above VSS or the input pair's tail source leaves saturation

tail_hdr_dropout_mv.description: same headroom at the 2.10 V dropout test point -- the NMOS pair's headroom is referenced to VCM and ground, so this must not move with VDD

vg_pulldown_mv.description: at the 2.10 V dropout test point the gate must reach ~VSS, which is the bias sim/devchar/CONCLUSIONS.md S1 measured Rds = 2.41 ohm at

vg_pullup_hdr_mv.description: VDD - OUT when driven off; the residual Vsg must stay far below the 0.622 V minimum |Vtp| so the pass device is off

ugbw_khz.description: UGBW floor keeps gain @ 1 kHz above the PSRR budget; the spread floor is a harness-integrity check that the corner .lib sections and .temp actually took effect

peak_excess_db.description: How far the amplifier's gain climbs back ABOVE its value at 200 kHz anywhere in 200 kHz - 5 MHz. Zero for a stable Type-II shelf, whose gain falls monotonically from the shelf through unity. A positive value is resonance in the amplifier's OWN local feedback loop -- the Rz/Cc Miller network around M2P and the class-AB gate buffer -- which is the loop that stays closed when the LDO loop is broken at ERRAMP_OUT/PASS_GATE. If it rings, the LDO loop gain T(s) has right-half-plane poles and DR-0001's Bode PM/GM criterion does not apply to it (spec/decision-records/DR-0008). 1 dB is numerical slack on a quantity that is exactly 0 for a monotone response, not a tuning allowance. Note the resolution it is read at: the shared `ac dec 40` sweep samples ~5.9 % frequency steps, so a high-Q peak's tip is undersampled and the number reported here UNDERSTATES the true peak -- measured at dec 200 on the same netlist the same peak reads 20-58 dB where this row reports 7-12 dB. It is a detector, not a measurement of the peak's height.

peak_excess_lightload_db.description: Same bar at the light-load operating point, where the class-AB buffer's pull-up is closest to cutoff and the local loop is least damped.
